task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Yearly Statistics' window or tab is visible, showing a breakdown of dive data by year.

task_completion.description: The statistics for the year 2011 are specifically selected or highlighted.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The year 2011 is selected in the statistics list, or the view is filtered to show only 2011 data.

integrity.description: The agent used the Subsurface GUI to find the information rather than just searching the filesystem.

integrity.description: The screenshot saved is an actual capture of the application UI, not a placeholder image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file /home/ga/Documents/yearly_stats.png, if previewed, matches the Subsurface UI seen in the trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: For the year 2011 in the Subsurface logbook: The total number of dives is exactly 12. The maximum depth reached is 46.48 meters. The summary file must follow the format 'Dives: [integer]' and 'Max Depth: [value] meters'. A depth value within 0.5m of 46.48m is acceptable.
